requirements.text: Operators can scan identity, current facts and next actions through consistent shared typography, spacing and hierarchy in existing list, detail and action-review compositions.
Operators can read essential facts and activate controls with long or missing data at narrow, desktop and tablet/coarse-pointer layouts, including text enlargement and zoom without lost task access.
Operators can select and retain Light, Dark or System, with one selected preference, correct effective styles and existing host-forced theme behavior.

Operators retain correct labels, icons, disabled state and task context through actual busy completion, repeated LiveView updates and reconnect, without premature enabling or replay of a staged action.

Keyboard users can complete touched navigation and review flows with visible focus, associated validation/status semantics, overlay containment and logical focus return after dismissal, correction or replacement.

Operators can distinguish empty, no-match, unavailable, partial, unsupported, denied, pending, failed and unknown states and choose the supported next step without inferred health or completion claims.
Maintainers can inspect current route, interaction, component and state coverage with source, fixture and served-asset provenance, keeping historical, rendered and exercised evidence distinct.

Maintainers receive faithful recurring regression proof with each delivery slice in existing acceptance owners, including focused failure controls for new guards and no confirmation-only human UAT dependency.
